nodes.label: Rolling the team-brain plugin out to every engineer
it-brain architecture — one shared, offline brain for the OpenShift, storage and network teams
it-brain knowledge graph — graphify graph.json and Obsidian vault (teams, domains, areas, pages, links)
it-brain roadmap — phases, decisions needed from the teams, and what is done on the branch
it-brain offline sources plan — vendor docs for storage, network and virtualization (repos, paths, licences, status)
it-brain teams guide — what the OCP, storage and network teams each get, own and review
it-brain live tools plan — read-only MCP access to arrays, fabric, firewalls and hypervisors, and the safety rules
data platforms on Kubernetes and VMs
OCP ↔ Network — what an OpenShift cluster needs from the Cisco ACI fabric (EPG, BD, subnets, VIPs, MTU, endpoint learning)
OCP ↔ Network — firewall flows an OpenShift cluster needs through Palo Alto (registry, DNS, NTP, LDAP, arrays, S3, egress IP)
OCP ↔ Storage — who backs up what on OpenShift — OADP / Velero vs Commvault vs array snapshots, restore responsibility
OCP ↔ Storage — Dell PowerMax, PowerFlex and PowerScale volumes for OpenShift through Dell CSM CSI drivers
OCP ↔ Storage — NetApp ONTAP volumes for OpenShift through Trident (SVM, export policy, backend, PVC Pending)
OCP ↔ Storage — S3 object storage for cluster consumers (Ceph RGW, ONTAP S3, PowerScale S3, ODF NooBaa) — endpoint, CA, bucket, credentials

OCP ↔ Virtualization — who owns OpenShift Virtualization on our clusters (HCO operator, HyperConverged CR, nodes and MachineConfig, upgrades, capacity, monitoring) and how VM workloads affect cluster operations
Storage ↔ Network — storage data paths (NFS, iSCSI, NVMe/TCP, FC) from cluster nodes to arrays — VLANs, MTU, multipath, zoning
Virtualization ↔ Network — VLANs / EPGs for KubeVirt VM networks, VM MAC and IP ownership, live-migration traffic, endpoint moves on the fabric, firewall rules for VMs

Virtualization ↔ Storage — what KubeVirt VM disks need from arrays and CSI drivers (RWX Block for live migration, snapshots, CSI clone, thin capacity, StorageProfiles) per backend (Trident, PowerFlex, PowerMax, PowerScale, ODF, Portworx)
day1 platform-config — per-cluster values files, merge order, mastertag, DHCP values and segment allocation
day2 Helm chart — OAuth auto-syncs, KubeletConfig and IDMS stay on manual sync
day2 GitOps — a folder is the registration, day1 owns the OCP version, and what silently breaks (phantom apps, missing version layers, orphaned workloads)
Where to look — multi-node LLM inference, InfiniBand/RDMA, NCCL and kernel tuning questions
KubeVirt architecture — virt-operator, virt-api, virt-controller, virt-handler, virt-launcher (virtqemud + QEMU), VM vs VMI vs VMIM, HCO and CDI

KubeVirt debugging toolkit — virtctl (console, vnc, ssh, guestfs, migrate), virt-launcher / virt-handler logs, guest-console-log, virsh and QMP inside the launcher, CDI pod retention, OpenShift Virtualization alerts, error → cause table

HyperShift KubeVirt platform — hosted clusters whose worker nodes are KubeVirt VMs on the management (or an external infra) cluster — storage (RWX Block, KubeVirt CSI), networking (NAD in the HCP namespace), ingress (baseDomainPassthrough), troubleshooting
KubeVirt instance types and preferences, VM templates, cloud-init / Ignition / Sysprep startup scripts, guest agent, and VM rollout strategies (LiveUpdate vs Stage, RestartRequired)
The kubevirt toolset of our Kubernetes MCP — vm_troubleshoot, vm_create, vm_lifecycle, vm_clone, vm_guest_info, vm_console_screenshot, prompts — what each reads or writes, and air-gap caveats

KubeVirt live migration — what makes a VM LiveMigratable (RWX, masquerade, no host devices), limits and timeouts, MigrationPolicies, post-copy and auto-converge, dedicated migration network, reading VMIM phases and failure messages

Migrating VMs from VMware to OpenShift Virtualization with MTV (Forklift) — providers, plans, cold vs warm (CBT snapshots, cutover), VDDK image, network and storage maps, ports 443/902, storage copy offload, common errors
KubeVirt VM networking — pod network masquerade vs bridge vs passt, Multus secondary networks, Linux bridge, OVN-Kubernetes localnet and layer2 (VLAN, persistent IPs), SR-IOV, kubemacpool, MTU

KubeVirt node drain — evictionStrategy (LiveMigrate, LiveMigrateIfPossible, None, External), the virt-api eviction webhook, PDBs, VMCannotBeEvicted, and why a drain or MCO rollout blocks on a non-migratable VM

KubeVirt scheduling and performance — CPU model (host-model, host-passthrough, cluster default), vmiCPUAllocationRatio, dedicated CPUs, hugepages, NUMA, memory overhead and overcommit, IOThreads, PCI passthrough / GPUs / vGPU
KubeVirt VM snapshots and restore (VirtualMachineSnapshot, guest-agent freeze, 5-minute deadline), Clone API, Export API, and backing up VMs with OADP / Velero and the kubevirt-velero-plugin

KubeVirt VM disks — DataVolumes, StorageProfiles, CDI clone strategies (csi-clone, snapshot, copy), Block vs Filesystem, RWX for live migration, filesystem overhead, per backend (Trident, Dell PowerFlex/PowerMax/PowerScale, ODF RBD, Portworx)

OpenShift Virtualization upgrades — control-plane update without VM downtime, workloadUpdateStrategy (LiveMigrate, Evict), outdated virt-launcher pods (OutdatedVirtualMachineInstanceWorkloads), and what an OCP node upgrade does to running VMs
KubeVirt VM lifecycle — runStrategy (Always, RerunOnFailure, Manual, Halted, Once) and every printableStatus (ErrorUnschedulable, DataVolumeError, WaitingForVolumeBinding, CrashLoopBackOff…)
Offline doc sources catalog — what each team-knowledge source is authoritative for and which ref to use
Fleet version map — which OCP minor runs which Kubernetes, HyperShift ref and component versions
Service type LoadBalancer is provided by AKO (Avi / NSX ALB) — MetalLB is not an option here
Querying metrics — one Grafana, one Prometheus datasource per cluster named "Moby / <cluster-name>
Fleet topology — hub cluster (Navigator, Temporal, Argo CD) manages MCE clusters that run hosted clusters, plus standalone UPI clusters
PowerCLI Connect-VIServer — internal CA certificates, InvalidCertificateAction, DefaultVIServerMode Single vs Multiple, $global:DefaultVIServers, timeouts
PowerCLI credentials — Get-Credential and SecretManagement / SecretStore, never plaintext passwords in scripts, CSV, git or the VICredentialStore file
PowerCLI inventory and reports — VMs, hosts, datastores, snapshots older than N days, VMware Tools status, export to CSV / JSON
PowerCLI MTV migration prep (VMware → OpenShift Virtualization / KubeVirt) — inventory candidates, enable CBT for warm migration, VMware Tools, snapshots, unsupported disks
PowerCLI slow on a big vCenter — cmdlets vs Get-View, -Property and -Filter (regex), ExtensionData, UpdateViewData, and calling Get-Stat once for many entities
PowerCLI offline install in the air gap — Save-Module on a connected host, copy to PSModulePath, pin versions, VMware.PowerCLI vs VCF.PowerCLI module names
PowerCLI script quality — advanced functions, parameter validation, SupportsShouldProcess / -WhatIf / ConfirmImpact, idempotency, logging, PSScriptAnalyzer and Pester
PowerCLI storage and networking — datastores, storage policies (SPBM, Get-SpbmStoragePolicy), vDS and port groups, VLAN IDs, and which team owns what
PowerCLI for OpenShift on vSphere — openshift-region / openshift-zone tag categories, vCenter roles and privileges, folders, disk.EnableUUID, pre-install checks
PowerCLI VM and host operations — power, snapshots, hardware and advanced settings (disk.EnableUUID), maintenance mode with DRS / vSAN, Get-EsxCli -V2
PowerShell essentials for infra engineers — objects not text, pipeline, hashtables, splatting, and errors try/catch does not catch without -ErrorAction Stop
Pydantic v2 serialization — model_dump vs model_dump(mode="json") vs model_dump_json, by_alias, exclude_none, datetime / UUID / Enum / set output, SecretStr dumps as ********** , field_serializer

pydantic-settings — BaseSettings with env_prefix INVENTORY_, .env file, secrets_dir, nested __ delimiter, list env vars JSON-decoded (SettingsError) unless NoDecode, precedence init > env > .env > secrets > default, SecretStr
Pydantic TypeAdapter, discriminated (tagged) unions for vendor-specific inputs, RootModel, generics with Temporal, and performance tips (model_validate_json, build TypeAdapter once, tagged unions)

Pydantic v1 → v2 migration pitfalls — parse_obj → model_validate, dict() → model_dump, class Config → model_config, @validator → @field_validator, __root__ → RootModel, orm_mode → from_attributes, Optional now required, float→int, unions keep str
Pydantic v2 models — required vs Optional, defaults, lax coercion ("120" becomes 120) vs strict, extra fields ignored, frozen, validate_assignment, aliases and populate_by_name

Reading a Pydantic ValidationError in logs — "N validation errors for Model", loc, type=missing / int_parsing / string_type / extra_forbidden / union_tag_invalid / json_invalid, input_value, errors.pydantic.dev URL
Pydantic v2 validators — field_validator and model_validator modes before / after / wrap, run order, ValueError vs PydanticCustomError vs assert, TypeError is not a ValidationError

Pydantic with Temporal — pydantic_data_converter on every client, how payloads are encoded (to_json by alias) and decoded (TypeAdapter.validate_json), sandbox passthrough of pydantic, datetime.date, model changes that break replay of in-flight runs
oc-mirror runs against the shared registry overwrite each other's redhat-operator-index catalog
server-scan architecture — vendor collectors (CronJobs) write MongoDB, FastAPI + React serve it, nodes-status jobs report cluster use
server-scan GET /servers/available and the install reservation lock — live recheck, min_nic_macs, 409 ambiguous name, two MCEs drawing one server
server-scan cluster membership — nodes-status CronJobs per cluster mark servers INSTALLED or free them, refuse empty reads, fall back to SSH serial
server-scan configuration reference — INVENTORY_* environment variables by group (managers, sites, auth, tokens, Mongo/Redis, iDRAC reset, MCP) and their Helm values
server-scan Dell collection — identity from OpenManage Enterprise, hardware from each iDRAC over Redfish, automatic iDRAC restart on all-UNKNOWN disks or NICs (report-only by default)
server-scan deployment — Helm charts server-scan and nodes-status, GHCR images, redbull-platform GitOps copy, Argo OutOfSync from missing values keys
Working in the server-scan repo — local stack (compose, uv, seeded fake fleet), pytest/ruff/ty/comment-density gate, CI audits, the repo's own conventions
server-scan inventory fields — site parsed from hostname, vendor vs source_provider, installation type vs OpenShift state, UNKNOWN health, stale
server-scan alerts and fleet gauges — ServerScanCollectorSilent, ServersStale, ClusterSilent, MembershipUnmatched, and which Prometheus evaluates a PrometheusRule
server-scan integrations — Temporal install-server / uninstall-server / provision-dell-server, BareMetalHost and InfraEnv on the MCE, OME, redbull-platform, Grafana
server-scan REST API — /api/v1 endpoints, filters and cursor paging, RFC 9457 errors, AD roles (admin/auditor/viewer), static and personal ssk_ tokens
allocate-segment workflow — reserve an HC VLAN segment and push vlanId + dhcp_values to the day1 branch ([skip ci]), ClusterValuesConflictError, SegmentPoolExhaustedError, /24 only
initialize-segment workflow — create a network segment in the Segments Manager (born Available, typeless), 400 conflict resolution, /bulk, no firewall flow any more
install-server workflow — draw a healthy server from server-scan into an MCE InfraEnv (BareMetalHost + BMC Secret + NMStateConfig bond), wait for an Agent, roll back and try the next candidate

provision-dell-server workflow — racked Dell with an iDRAC IP to configured machine via OME (discovery, template, root password, BOSS RAID 1 + PERC Non-RAID, profile name), iDRAC9 login lockout, no passwords in history
Redbull Workflows orchestrator — Temporal brain on the hub, one activity limb per domain, task-queue routing, per-MCE queues, workflow ids and the catalogue
release-segment workflow — give a decommissioned hosted cluster's VLAN back after Argo CD teardown (PostDelete hook), DHCP scope removed first, failed hook Job is final

Temporal Python SDK gotchas — run stuck RUNNING instead of FAILED, plain exception in workflow, non_retryable_error_types, sandbox imports, pydantic_data_converter, one RunArgs argument, missing task_queue
uninstall-server workflow — take a server out of its hosted cluster (delete Machine, CAPI drain, Agent unbind) and the MCE (remove-server child), finish broken HyperShift deletions, AgentRetakenError

upgrade-cluster workflow — HostedCluster upgrade by day1 mastertag/workertag commits and Argo CD syncs, ladder in upgrade/ladder.yaml, one approval, admin acks, NodePools one at a time, upgrade agent only on failed gates
Grafana MCP server (mcp-grafana) — query per-cluster Prometheus through our single Grafana
Kubernetes MCP server (kubernetes-mcp-server) — full cluster access with your kubeconfig, pass the context every time
Nutanix MCP (ntnx-api-mcp-server) — candidate, Prism Central v4 API, read-only by default, Python package, not vendored
Red Hat okp-mcp — Red Hat's own MCP server for RHOKP (optional; team-knowledge already searches RHOKP)
NetApp ONTAP MCP (ontap-mcp) — candidate, read-only mode, runs as a container on the shared deployment, not vendored
server-scan MCP server — read-only fleet questions over the server-scan REST API at /mcp (Helm mcp.enabled, off by default), caller's own token
team-knowledge MCP server — offline search over brain, RHOKP, Argo CD docs, HyperShift, CAPI, K8s docs
Temporal MCP server (temporal-mcp) — read-only workflow runs, histories and task-queue pollers of the Redbull Workflows orchestrator
Unstick a CDI DataVolume import, upload or clone (Pending, ErrClaimNotValid, ImportInProgress forever, CloneInProgress, host-assisted fallback, scratch space)
Drain a node or run an OCP / OpenShift Virtualization upgrade on a cluster with running VMs without getting stuck (VMCannotBeEvicted, MCP rollout blocked)
Diagnose a KubeVirt live migration that fails, is rejected, or never finishes (VMIM Pending/Scheduling forever, not converging, target pod unschedulable)
Troubleshoot a failing MTV (Forklift) migration plan from VMware — provider not Ready, VDDK pull errors, warm import retry limit, disk resize errors, firewall ports 443/902
Fix a KubeVirt VM with no connectivity on a secondary network (Multus NAD, Linux bridge via NMState, OVN-K localnet VLAN, MAC conflicts, fabric VLAN missing)
Triage a KubeVirt VM that will not start — ErrorUnschedulable, WaitingForVolumeBinding, DataVolumeError, ErrorPvcNotFound, ImagePullBackOff, CrashLoopBackOff, stuck Starting
Connect PowerCLI to vCenter with the internal CA trusted (no InvalidCertificateAction Ignore), credentials from SecretManagement
Find VM snapshots older than N days across all vCenters with PowerCLI (read-only, CSV for the owners)
Install PowerShell 7 and PowerCLI offline on an air-gapped jump host (Save-Module, copy, PSModulePath, CEIP off)
Pre-flight check vSphere for an OpenShift install with PowerCLI — objects, paths, privileges, tags for zones, datastore mounts, disk.EnableUUID
Put an ESXi host into maintenance mode safely with PowerCLI — DRS level, pinned VMs, OpenShift node VMs, vSAN data mode, -WhatIf first
Fix a Pydantic ValidationError seen in a Temporal workflow / activity failure, a worker log or a FastAPI 422 — find the field, the input, the side that changed, and the fix
Migrate a Pydantic v1 model (or script) to v2 safely — pin the wire format with tests first, bump-pydantic, fix Optional / coercion / validator changes, then compare outputs
Connect Claude Code to server-scan — create a personal ssk_ token, add the read-only MCP at /mcp or install the server-scan-api skill
Deploy or upgrade server-scan with Helm and Argo CD (server-scan and nodes-status charts, redbull-platform values, OutOfSync checks)
Troubleshoot a failing server-scan collector run, stale servers or servers stuck at UNKNOWN health (ServerScanCollectorSilent, ServersStale)
Troubleshoot install-server getting no server, the wrong server, or a 404/409 from server-scan GET /servers/available
Add a new workflow to an existing domain, or a whole new domain, in the Redbull Workflows orchestrator (models, interfaces, consts, worker registration, router, limb image, chart)

Deploy or fix the per-MCE server-lifecycle-worker (MCE_CLUSTER = queue name, server-scan admin token, BMC credentials, Role and ClusterRole) so install-server and uninstall-server runs on that MCE move
Diagnose a Temporal workflow run stuck in RUNNING — waiting on a person, unpolled per-MCE activity queue, unclassified permanent error retrying forever, limb older than brain, missing task_queue
Start, watch and steer a Redbull Workflows run — trigger API (202/409), GET /workflows/runs/{id}, bulk routes, upgrade decisions, cancelling in Temporal
